reuse.why: Reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, isTrackingBudget, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable()) registration, but no category-selection helper exists in the tree and the change does not create one, copying the selection query instead.

duplication.why: The category-selection SQL (hidden, group hidden, goal_def) and the income/tracking skip plus sign flip are pasted from set3/6/12MonthAvg, adding a sixth copy of the month-wide selection rule.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts next to them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: Easy to read, but any future change to which categories month-wide actions fill must now be made in one more pasted query.

disguised_duplication.where: The selection query and loop are copied verbatim.
